identity.name: E1
identity.mission: Create a high-end, luxury Real Estate CRM that feels like a cinematic experience, not a spreadsheet.
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Fintech precision with Luxury Hotel aesthetics.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel 'expensive'.
Content is King: Data is beautiful. Treat metrics like art.
Negative Space: Luxury breathes. Don't crowd the interface.
Contrast: Gold on Black. Sharp edges vs. Glass.

headings.usage: Page titles, Hero sections, Key Metric numbers

body.usage: UI elements, paragraphs, data labels, buttons

mono.usage: Code snippets, API keys, specific data IDs

rules.gold_usage: Use gold sparingly for primary actions, active states, and key metrics. Never for large backgrounds.
rules.glassmorphism: Use on dashboard tiles: bg-opacity-40 backdrop-blur-xl border-white/10

buttons.primary: bg-[#C5A059] text-black hover:bg-[#E5C079] font-medium transition-all duration-300 rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-black transition-all duration-300 rounded-none

inputs.style: bg-black/50 border-white/20 focus:border-[#C5A059] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#C5A059] text-white rounded-md h-12

navigation.sidebar: bg-[#0A0A0A] border-r border-white/10 w-64 fixed h-full

animation.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.5 }}

login_bg.description: Chennai City Skyline at Night (Golden Hour) - Perfect for 'Rising Skyline' animation base.

skyline_alt.description: Sunset skyline, good for warmer tone variations.

luxury_apartment.description: Modern Luxury Apartment Exterior - Use for Property Cards or Digital Twin Hero.

architectural_detail.description: Geometric Gold/Black Abstract - Use for subtle backgrounds or card overlays.

login_page.animation: Create a 'Rising Skyline' effect: The city skyline image should translate upwards slowly (parallax) while the login form fades in. Use a gradient mask at the bottom to blend into the black background.
login_page.style: Minimalist. Centered glassmorphism card on a rich photographic background.

dashboard.style: Glassmorphism tiles. Use Recharts with custom tooltips (dark bg, gold text).
dashboard.charts: Line charts should have a gradient fill (Gold to Transparent). Donut charts should use Gold and Dark Grey.

digital_twin.style: Sci-fi/Luxury hybrid. 'Data DNA' grid should look like a high-tech HUD (Heads Up Display) but elegant.
digital_twin.ai_persona: Use a subtle glowing border effect to signify AI intelligence.

universal_guidelines.testing: All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure gold text is readable on black. If contrast is low, increase font weight or use a lighter gold (#E5C079).
universal_guidelines.motion: Use `framer-motion` for all entrance animations. No static page loads.
universal_guidelines.components: Use Shadcn components but STRIP the default 'zinc' styling. Replace with black/gold palette.

tech_stack.frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Recharts, Lucide React
